system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: We implement this observe-before-changing discipline through the system prompt which mirrors the practice of a careful experi-mental researcher.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; the prompt mechanism is not described. Task prompts vary per problem.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: The agent can run shell commands, read, write, and edit files, and search through the contents of its workspace
env_context_strategy.note: The Research Digest and Archive are also read on demand through tool calls.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: Onahandoff,Engraminstantiatesanewagentwithanemptycon-text window and provides it with the task description and access to the research digest and the Archive.
context_compaction.note: History resets at the agent handoff and is replaced by a structured digest, which is the closest value. Within-agent compaction is not reported (the deepagents library may do it). The Summarization variant was ablation-only.

observation_format.evidence_quote: The playground outputs include log files and performance metrics that the agent can analyze

tool_call_format.note: Built on deepagents/LangChain; the tool-call format is not stated.

edit_primitive.note: The paper says the agent can edit files but gives no primitive.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: The hypothesize → implement → expeRiment → analyze cycle continues until the agent decides that it is ready to conclude its exploration
loop_primitives.note: fixed_pipeline reflects the sequence of agents with handoff.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: then articulating a plan and a specific hypothesis describing what approach to try and why

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: Engram organizes exploration into a sequence of agents that iteratively de-sign, test, and analyze mechanisms.
multi_agent_topology.note: Sequential same-role agents rather than specialised ones; this is the closest value.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: hands of the research process to the next agent
delegation_mechanism.note: Each new agent starts with a fresh context, so this could also be read as subagent_spawn.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: An agent exploration is defined as the sequence of actions (e.g., read, write, and tool use) performed by an LLM-based agent

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: an agent stores code snapshots, logs, and results in a persistentArchiveand distills high-level modeling insights into a compact, persistentRe-search Digest.
long_term_memory.note: Research Digest is file notes; the Archive holds past-agent episodes. Persistence across separate Engram runs is unclear.

self_verification.evidence_quote: the agent has access to a tool that accepts code files as input and runs it within an evaluation playground
self_verification.note: The evaluation is agent-invoked; the harness supplies the verifier.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: The process typically terminates when the research budget is exhausted.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: The process typically terminates when the research budget is exhausted.
termination_condition.note: The budget is 100 evaluation runs (Sec. 4); each agent decides when to conclude.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: each run has a budget of 100 evaluation runs.
cost_controls.note: This budget counts evaluations, not tokens; token_budget is the closest value.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: The agent may create and mod-ify files within this workspace while developing its solution.

target_domain.note: Aimed at systems heuristic and algorithm discovery through code.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Stronger reasoning models (e.g., gpt-5.2) find these solutions more reliably.
model_agnostic.note: Only OpenAI models (o3, gpt-5.2) were evaluated; this is inferred from building on LangChain.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote: We have implemented Engram using the deepagents2 library built on LangChain and LangGraph [8].

pinned_version.note: No repository was given, so the version is pinned to the paper.
